answer: Every account pays a flat epoch fee into a shared pool, no discounts and no exemptions, so each puppet pays what an honest node pays: cost linear in N. Each epoch a random sample is audited for verified output; passing accounts earn the fee back, failures forfeit it. A newcomer's shell stays hard like a walnut: no new vertex dodges the fee, since each pays across the full refund horizon before a rebate accrues. A farm drains a pool funded mostly by its own puppets' fees; honest users pay once and recover it via normal work.
